_comment: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transaction-variance card copy.
Nothing else may hold these values. The renderer in RRV8/inventory-transactions.html,
the AI prompt contract in RRV8/config.js, and docs/plans/txv-card-copy-standard.md all
DERIVE from this file, and Tools/check_txv_cards.py FAILS the build when any of them
disagrees with it. That cross-check is the anti-drift mechanism: a document nobody
verifies is a fourth opinion, not a standard.
Editing a value here changes the gate. Update the renderer and the prompt in the same
commit or the gate will tell you which one you forgot.

headings._comment: Exact section headings, in render order. `field` is the card-object key that feeds each. Renamed from 'What I checked'/'To stop it recurring' on 2026-08-12: those named the TOOL'S process, and a new analyst wants the state of the world and the next move.

_bulletWordLimitWhy: The approved Sales DMAAI Net Zero card's longest surviving bullet is 22 words. Above roughly 25 a bullet is carrying two ideas or explaining method.

bannedPhrases._comment: Method and scaffolding. Each was live card copy removed on 2026-08-12 because it explained HOW the tool decided rather than WHAT is true, and none of it changed the analyst's next move. Matched case-insensitively as substrings.
phrases: because that column is a float
then Mark reviewed to record it
is left unclaimed rather than claimed on a majority

pluralAgreement._comment: '1 DMAAI resolve' and '1 rows of 71' both shipped. A count concatenated onto a hardcoded plural noun cannot be right for n=1. Regex is applied to card copy AND to the renderer source.

_comment: The 21 cards written before the standard existed. Their format violations report
as WARN instead of FAIL so the gate goes green today and still blocks NEW drift.
This is a BACKLOG, not an exemption: 123 warnings at the time of writing, 2026-08-12.
Remove a code once its card is rewritten to the standard and the gate holds it there
permanently. SAC is deliberately absent: it is the worked example and must not regress.
Every code here is a real card in RRV8/config.js. A code for a card that does not exist
silently exempts nothing and rots, so the list is validated against the catalog.

derivedFiles._comment: Files that restate this standard and are cross-checked by the gate. A mismatch is a FAIL, naming the file that drifted.

humanRules._comment: NOT machine-checkable. Listed so the standard is complete and so nobody mistakes a passing gate for a good card. Rule 1 is the one that mattered most and the one no gate can see.
rules: A bullet is a fact or an action, never a method. The gate approximates this with bannedPhrases and the word limit; it cannot actually tell them apart.
A panel may say only what its own table proves. The Variance Analyzer chip led with the card name while its table showed an account mismatch.
Never instruct the analyst to use a control that is on screen.
Scope appears once. The header strip owns it.
No bullet may repeat an appended block.
